group.label: Health emails
group.comment: Free, no MageSentinel account needed. The checks on MageSentinel > Store health run every 15 minutes through Magento's cron and email you when one turns red, and again when it is fixed. Sent through your store's own mail; nothing leaves the server.

field.label: Email me when a health check turns red
field.comment: Paused while MageSentinel is connected and checking the store, because it sends the alerts then. Resumes on its own if it stops for three hours.

field.label: Send to
field.comment: Empty: the General Contact address (Stores > Configuration > Store Email Addresses).

field.label: Weekly summary email
field.comment: Every Monday morning: last week's orders, revenue, average order and cancelled or unpaid orders against the week before, with any health check that needs a look.

group.label: MageSentinel connector
group.comment: Optional. Connects this store to a MageSentinel account (14 days free, no card): a real browser buys from your store on a schedule and tells you which step broke. Paste the token from your MageSentinel dashboard.

field.label: Enable diagnostics endpoint
field.comment: Read-only. Exposes store health data to MageSentinel. Disabled by default.

field.label: Access token
field.comment: Shared secret. Requests without a matching X-MageSentinel-Token are refused.

field.label: Let MageSentinel cancel its own test orders
field.comment: Off by default. When a check places a real order to prove checkout works, this lets it cancel that order afterwards so your order list does not fill up with synthetic ones. It can only cancel orders placed by MageSentinel, created in the last hour, not yet invoiced and not yet shipped — never a customer's order. Cancels, never deletes.

field.label: Let MageSentinel's checks past your CAPTCHA
field.comment: Off by default. MageSentinel never solves a CAPTCHA, so a checkout or login that asks for one stops its checks there. Switch this on and requests that carry this store's access token are served without reCAPTCHA or Magento's image CAPTCHA. Every other visitor still gets it.
